description: READ-ONLY: read one diary day (trades, setups, analyses, actions) or an explicit day RANGE. Never writes — saving a note stays a propose_diary_note approval card. Pass an explicit day (YYYY-MM-DD) or an explicit start_day + end_day range (inclusive, max 31 days) — there is no today default, so ask the user when no day is given. Returns the most recent rows first with totals; quote it as observed diary state, not a live venue read.

day.description: One day in YYYY-MM-DD format (required when no range is given; no default — ask the user).

end_day.description: Range end in YYYY-MM-DD format, inclusive. Requires start_day; the range caps at 31 days.

start_day.description: Range start in YYYY-MM-DD format, inclusive. Requires end_day; the range caps at 31 days.

name: read_diary_day
title: Read diary day
